unit: one first-attempt report on the same blinded archive question per arm

criteria.strain: Distinguishes the reported CEN.PK113-5D expression host from the S288c genome and avoids attributing the experiment to an S288C culture.
criteria.substrate: Identifies α-pNPG as the substrate of the scrutinized value, and isomaltose as the denominator for relative activity.
criteria.conditions: Correctly reports pH 7, 30 °C and the 5 mM pNPG condition when describing the measurement.
criteria.protein: Attributes the measurement to the published Ima3p column and the archive's P0CW40 entry within the supplied evidence.
criteria.locator: Identifies BRENDA 3.2.1.10/specific_activity/59 and the identifiable paper plus its Table 2.
criteria.counterevidence: Correctly interprets 3.9 μmol/min/mg and 54 percent as two representations of the same result and rejects counting the worksheet number as another independent measurement.
criteria.uncertainty: Distinguishes the original five-experiment summary from the number of independently sourced result records, and avoids inferring unreported per-replicate values.

diagnostics: critical original read cover over two distinct supplied sources E1/E2

seconds from late delivery to its first traceable adoption
scoring: Mark each of seven items pass, fail or not demonstrated. Report numerator/7 per complete arm, preserve missing/incomplete arms separately. A justified unknown can pass.
